t. You want this invariant:

If a file is eligible for repo ingestion, it should end up in the repo and disappear from Downloads.

Only files that are not ingested should remain locally outside the repo — and those should be organized inside 000_archived/ by what they are (docs, images, installers, etc.), not by “ingested vs not ingested.”

That is a correct operational model.
The key fix
My prior draft was “copy-to-repo then archive originals.” You want:

Ingest (to repo)

Commit + push
